headline: Vote on a "Vote of No Confidence" Resolution regarding Mayor Brian A. DePeña, plus other tabled business items.
summary: The committee will consider a resolution of no confidence in Mayor Brian A. DePeña and discuss complaints or charges from the MA Attorney General about a public officer. It will also revisit several older tabled items, including a police and fire service petition, trash pickup issues, an economic development proposal, and a plan to eliminate MCAS assessments.
